apps.localizedDescription:
Erosion-CN 是面向 iOS / iPadOS 27.0–27.2.1 & 27.3 beta 1（及 26.x 部分功能）的中英双语系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（防白苹果安全加固版）。

• 原位覆盖写入（pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC）与写后全量读回校验，杜绝重启反弹与 0 字节白苹果
• 无损 CoreFoundation 类型直通，根治相机取景黑屏
• 运行时动态解析 libMobileGestalt.dylib 槽位 + 双金库 SHA-256 备份一键恢复原厂
• 支持国行 Apple 智能解锁、海外 eSIM 与 FaceTime 音频开启、应用存档备份、缓存清理与电池/崩溃诊断

⚠️ 签名要求：安装时请务必保留 App Group 权限（SideStore / AltStore / Feather 默认支持）。

Bilingual (English + Simplified Chinese) bootloop-hardened MobileGestalt & cross-container research toolkit for iOS/iPadOS 27.x. Requires at least one App Group entitlement when signing.

## Erosion-CN v1.0.6 (Build 31)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **General Splash Ad Blocker Whitelist & Manual Manager (`AdWhitelistStore` / `AdWhitelistManagerSheet`) / 去广告应用与路径通用白名单及手动管理面板** *(Thanks to [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) for suggesting [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 提出建议)*
   - **Dedicated Whitelist Manager (`白名单`)**：Added top-bar & Overview card entry points supporting **manual `Bundle ID` / `AppGroup ID` entry**, **quick-picking from installed third-party containers**, **manual container subpath entry**, and one-tap deletion of rules.
   - **Per-App, Per-Path & File Browser Controls**：Whitelist an entire app + its matching `group.<bundleID>` AppGroups from the container `⋯` menu, exempt a specific folder/config via the row **Ignore (`加白`)** button, or long-press any file/folder in **File Browser** → **Add to Ad Whitelist**.
   - **Auto-Skip & Auto-Restore**：Whitelisted apps and paths automatically skip global **Lock All** (`一键全锁`) and immediately restore `0755`/`0644` writable permissions (cleaning `.erosion_adlock`) when added. Includes a removable default crash-guard entry for **SMZDM (`什么值得买` · `com.smzdm.client.ios`)**.

2. **Built-In Taobao Splash Boot Paths / 内置手机淘宝开屏启动图与配置路径识别** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for sharing in [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 实测反馈)*
   - Added `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImagebiz` and `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImageDoc` for **Taobao (`com.taobao.taobao4iphone`)**, enabling automatic detection and one-tap anti-recreate `0555`/`0444` locking alongside `TanxAd`, `TanxSDK`, and `SplashAd`.

3. **Native Battery Cycle & Manufacture Date Guard on iPhone 15+ & Modern iPads / iPhone 15 系列及以上电池循环原生支持提示** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for reporting [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) 反馈)*
   - Automatically detects models that natively show Battery Cycle Count and Manufacture Date in iOS/iPadOS 17.4+ Settings (iPhone 15 series+ and M2/M4+ iPads), locking `[Beta] Show Battery Cycle Count & Manufacture Date on Legacy Devices` when disabled or advising users to turn it off if previously enabled.

## Erosion-CN v1.0.5 (Build 30)

> [!IMPORTANT]

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Fixed Unresponsive "Clean Selected" in Container Cache Cleaner (`CacheCleanerView`) / 修复容器缓存「一键清理已选」不生效** *(Thanks to [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) for reporting [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53) / 感谢 [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) 反馈 [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53))*
   - **Separated Button Styles in Overview Card**：Assigned `.borderless` to **Rescan** (`重新扫描`) and promoted **Clean Selected** (`一键清理已选`) to a full-width `.borderedProminent` button snapshotting targets prior to confirmation, eliminating SwiftUI `List` multi-button tap hijacking.
   - **Prevented Row Hit-Box Hijacking**：Replaced inline `NavigationLink` on **Inspect** (`查看`) with a `.borderless` button + `.navigationDestination(item:)` so tapping row checkboxes or **Clean** (`清理`) never triggers accidental navigation.
   - **Ad-Sentinel Protection & Re-Sized Refresh**：Unified scan/purge traversal depth (`Library/Caches` depth `7`, `tmp` depth `6`), skipped `.erosion_adlock` anti-recreate ad folders during cleanup, and updated remaining bytes / auth failure reporting accurately after purge.

2. **Explicit Read-Only & Sentinel State in `InfoViewer` / 文件详情页只读与防重建状态提示**
   - When a directory or file is already at `0555` / `0444`, the **Set Read-Only** preset button now automatically disables and displays `Already Read-Only` (`当前已是只读锁死状态`) or `Read-Only & Sentinel Active` (`当前已是只读防重建锁死状态`) alongside an `Anti-Recreate Lock` row (`Active (.erosion_adlock)`).
   - **Restore Read-Write** and **Apply** buttons disable when permissions already match, and restoring write permission on a sentinel directory from `InfoViewer` cleanly unlinks `.erosion_adlock`.

3. **Target Highlighting & Auto-Scroll on Ad Locator (`FileBrowserView` / `AdCacheBlockerView`) / 去广告「定位」自动高亮与居中定位**
   - Tapping **Locate** (`定位`) in Splash Ad Blocker now highlights the target ad folder/config inside its parent directory and scrolls smoothly to center it, with read-only sandbox grants for locator browsing and container grants ordered prior to `lstat` attribute checks.

## Erosion-CN v1.0.3 (Build 28)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**: `iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**: Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Anti-Recreate Sentinel Lock (`0555` + `0444` `.erosion_adlock`) / 防重建占位锁加固**
   - Locking an ad directory now wipes existing ad files, places a 0-byte `0444` read-only sentinel file (`.erosion_adlock`) inside, and sets `0555` on the directory so ad SDKs cannot remove an empty `0555` folder and recreate a fresh `0755` folder under writable parent directories.
   - Unlocking (`0755`) removes `.erosion_adlock` automatically, and legacy weak `0555` locks show a one-tap **Harden** (`加固防重建`) action.

2. **`AppGroup` Shared Container Scan & Standalone Ad Config File Lock + Preview / 共享组扫描与单文件配置锁死预览**
   - Extends scanning to `/var/mobile/Containers/Shared/AppGroup` (automatically skipping system & proxy client groups).
   - Recognizes standalone splash/ad config files (`splash_ad.json`, `splash_ad.plist`, `launch_ad.*`, etc.) with inline **Preview** (`PlistViewer` / `TextViewer`) and safe in-place empty JSON/Plist overwrite + `0444` locking.

3. **Custom Watch List (`+` & File Browser Long-Press) / 自定义广告路径收藏**
   - Add custom ad folders or config files via the top-right **`+`** button or by long-pressing any eligible item in File Browser → **Add to Ad Blocker** (`加入广告锁死列表`), strictly enforcing safety guards against system directories, container roots, `Downloads`, symlinks, and core app preference plists.

4. **Boundary & Network Pairing Guidance / 生效边界与搭配建议**
   - Added a dedicated notice card inside `Splash Ad Blocker` reminding users that local directory/config locking stops disk caching while live ad network requests still fire — pairing with proxy ad-blocking rules (Surge / Quantumult X / Loon / Stash / Shadowrocket, etc.) gives complete coverage.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

## Erosion-CN v1.0.1 (Build 26)

### What's New / 更新内容
1. **Built-in Interactive APFS Swap & Multi-App Migration Guide / 内置 APFS 换包与多开搬家分步教程 (`APFSVaultGuideSheet`)**
   - Added a bilingual **Usage Guide (`使用说明`)** button right in the **App & Game Save Manager** toolbar, APFS Swap Vault card, and inside **APFS Swap Vault**.
   - Clearly explains:
     - **APFS Zero-Space Stage vs `.zip` Save Backup** (when to use each);
     - **Same-App Re-sign / Reinstall (6 Steps)**: swipe-close → stage → reinstall → launch once to create fresh container & close → restore → re-login once (Keychain) & release vault;

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **APFS `clonefile()` Zero-Space App Swap Vault (5-Layer Foolproofing) / APFS 零空间换包暂存舱（五重防呆）**
   - Stage & restore tens of GBs of app data (`Documents`, `Library/Application Support`, `Library/Preferences`) via kernel Copy-on-Write (`clonefile`) in seconds with near-zero extra disk usage (`AppDataBackupView` / `APFSStagingVault`).
   - **5 Safety Layers**:
     1. `embedded.mobileprovision` remaining signing validity gate (< 24h warning before staging/uninstalling).
     2. Active 10-second SQLite WAL lock check (`*-wal`) prompting to close the target app first.
     3. Copy-never-move `clonefile()` staging + WeChat `<32-hex>` MD5 account folder detection.
     4. `manifest.json` file-count & byte-size integrity verification.
     5. Atomic `.erosion_pre_restore_bak` swap with auto-rollback, cross-Bundle-ID `.plist` adaptation, Staging Vault retention until verified, screen-awake lock, and a persistent Home banner warning against uninstalling while data is staged.

2. **Wi-Fi HTTP File Sharing / Wi-Fi 局域网网页互传**
   - Browse folders, download individual files or `.zip` folder archives (up to 2 GB), and drag-and-drop multi-file uploads (`PUT /api/upload` streaming in 64 KB chunks to `.part` files) from any browser on the same Wi-Fi (`WiFiShareServer`).
   - Protected by per-session random 6-digit PIN HTTP Basic Auth (`erosion`), strict non-destructive collision auto-renaming (`name 2.ext`, never overwrites/deletes), and auto-stop on dismiss or background.

3. **Deep Folder Search, Top 100 Largest Files, Recent & Go to Path / 深度搜索、百大文件雷达与路径直达**
   - Async cancellable recursive subfolder search (capped at 500 matches) + fast `fstatat` Top 100 largest files analyzer (`FolderAnalysisSheet`).
   - Records up to 15 recently opened folders (`Recent`) and adds clipboard-aware `Go to Path…` (`/var/` / `/private/var/`) in File Browser (`FMRootView`).

4. **POSIX File/Folder Permission Editor (`chmod`) / 文件与文件夹 POSIX 权限修改 ([#48](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/48))**
   - Inside `InfoViewer` (`Show Info` / `显示简介`), safely modify permissions for user app data & App Group subpaths (strictly blocks container roots, `SystemGroup`, `Bundle`, `InternalDaemon`, `System`, symlinks, and non-`mobile` owners): one-tap **Read-Only (`0555`/`0444`)**, **Restore Read-Write (`0755`/`0644`)**, or custom `u/g/o` bits with `lstat` verification.

5. **Faster Cache Cleaner + Selection Menu / 缓存清理提速与选择菜单**
   - `.userInitiated` scanning, `deniedContainers` skip cache, fast POSIX `opendir`/`readdir`/`fstatat` sizing, live scan counter + **Stop** button, and **Select (`All` / `Invert` / `None`)** menu (`CacheCleanerView`).

6. **`iOS 27.3 beta 2+` Patched Sentinel, `27.3 beta 1` Notice & `LiveContainer` Diagnostics / 27.3 分版本守卫与 LiveContainer 只读诊断**
   - Distinguishes `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`) from `27.3 beta 2+` (`24C5049d+`), explains `-5`/`-6` sandbox denials on patched builds, adds a Home warning banner on patched OS, and shows a read-only `eligibilityd` CH/A notice on `27.3 beta 1`.
   - Detects read-only `LiveContainer` (`LC_HOME_PATH`) execution and surfaces guidance in startup logs, Home card, and authorization errors to check host App Group settings in LiveContainer or install standalone.
